text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Bring it on. Huuup-hauser!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm passing behind the school building
when I spot
Matikanetannhauser
engaged in what looks like a
sumo match
with a tree.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hauser! ...Oh, hello there! It's exactly
what it
looks like! I'm practicing my
hugging!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't suppose you remember that
incident
with Taiki? When she went in
for a hug and I froze
up?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I hate hugs or anything! I like
messing
around with my friends as much
as the next
person...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's just that... Taiki gives very loving hugs! You can really feel all the love she puts into them!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
She squeezes the life out of you! And as
happy as
it makes me, it's even more
embarrassing! Does
that make sense?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's why taking the hug normally isn't
good
enough. I've gotta put just as much
love into it as
I get.
choice_data_list: 言ってることはなんとなく……
choice_data_list_en: I kind of get what you're saying...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
So after she grabs me, maybe I should
spin
around like this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Or how about this? Or this?!
Hiyaaah!
Dosukoiser!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think a normal hug would be perfectly
fine, but
Matikanetannhauser looks
serious. Maybe this is
the time to give
her some advice...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! Would you mind helping me

practice?! I need to figure out how to
best put
some love into it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I mean, you can't really get the knack of
hugging
from a tree... They don't react
at all.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Plus, the first thing I need to do is practice getting hugged! There's really no point otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the reason, as both an adult
and a
trainer, there are issues with
sweeping a student
into a love-filled
hug...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, don't be shy! Hug me with

everything you got!
choice_data_list: 悪いんだけど、他の子に――
choice_data_list_en: Sorry, but maybe one of the other girls—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Someone's going to get the wrong idea
at this
rate! I keep trying to talk her out
of it, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-what... What are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Too late.
Panicked, I open my mouth to
clear up the
misunderstanding, when—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: We're expressing our love!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser innocently throws
oil on the
fire. I've got to keep my cool
and set the record
straight!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so that's what's going on... Well, I
guess that
makes sense. You had me
scared for a second
there...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry about that. I got so wrapped up
in things,
I wasn't thinking...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Now there's an idea! Plus, since
we're both
Umamusume, the hugs will
have the right power
and grip!
choice_data_list: 折角だし、メジロドーベルと練習したら？
choice_data_list_en: Since you have the chance, why not practice with Mejiro Dober?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Besides, aren't you Taiki's roommate?!
You must
be real used to her hugs by
now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-well, I suppose that's true, but I don't
see why
that means I have t—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yeehaw! Well if that ain't just perfect!
Now, be a
doll and teach me your ways!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Nobody said you had to act like
Taiki too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their hugs don't look particularly
loving—more
just like two students
messing around—but it's a
heartwarming
sight nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain everything, starting from the
beginning,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain everything, starting from the
beginning,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
B-but... what are you doing behind the
building in
the first place? That just
sounds like an excuse to
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I see... Still, I think it's a little strange to
be
hugging in a place like this. You
know, with no
one around.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Excuse for what?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I'm sorry... I got way too carried
away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It doesn't matter! The point is this is not okay! You come with me right now, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean... you don't have to apologize.
It's not like
I can't sympathize with your
situation...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uh...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Now! Move it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hey, wait!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Dober?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober flees the scene, dragging

Matikanetannhauser behind her by the
hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober turns on her heel in a huff,
and
Matikanetannhauser practically
chases after her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem like we cleared anything
up...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, that was a whirlwind...
